<h1 class="hero-title">Francisco Calvillo</h1>

<p class="hero-subtitle">PhD in Mathematics · Sorbonne Université</p>

<p class="hero-intro" style="font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.7; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; max-width: 690px;">I am a mathematician working at the intersection of probability theory, statistics, and combinatorics, with interests in random graphs, discrete random structures, and probabilistic aspects of quantum error correction. A recurring theme in my research is inference from partial information: what can be learned about the structure of a network or probabilistic model from limited observations? I am particularly interested in problems of reconstruction, estimation, and hypothesis testing, as well as the asymptotic behavior of random systems.</p>
